messages.subject: Update
parts:
Hi all,

It's been a while since I've posted to the group.  I'm going to try to make it more of a practice to hop on the mailing list periodically to provide news of new developments in Tessera.

There's been a ton of activity going on, so much so that haven't left myself time for communication.  I put up a new post on the blog today covering some of the activity that has been going on recently: http://tessera.io/blog/tessera-update/.  I hope to be doing a lot more posting in the near future.

Also, I've been having a great deal of personal correspondences regarding Tessera.  I'm going to start trying to direct those to the mailing list so that they are useful for others.

This mailing list is a great place to ask questions or show off things you have been working on.  Please don't be afraid to jump in!

Ryan
